Title: Cold start time
Steps: 1. Launch app fresh. 2. Measure to interactive Today.
Expected Result: Under ~3s on web dev (note: dev-mode caveat); no long blank screen

Title: History list scroll at scale
Steps: 1. Open entries. 2. Fling-scroll top to bottom.
Expected Result: No frame stalls; images/text render progressively; no crash

Title: Typing latency during stream
Steps: 1. Type a message while assistant streams.
Expected Result: No input lag or dropped keystrokes; composer stays responsive
Evidence: PASS (web): typed a 46-character string into the composer while the assistant reply was streaming - every character registered, the value round-tripped, and no THINKING/disabled state blocked the input. Note: a true per-keystroke latency figure is not available through this harness.

Title: Tab switch speed
Expected Result: No blank flashes; no scroll position loss; no memory climb (check DevTools)
Evidence: 10 in-app tab switches alternating Threads/Insights: 718 - 1104 - 1010 - 1038 - 996 - 1028 - 1088 - 1001 - 1005 - 1025 ms (includes Playwright click resolution). No freeze - no blank frame - no re-render storm
Notes: Timing includes locator actionability wait so treat it as an upper bound; steady-state is ~1.0 s per switch on web

Title: Session compact on long chat
Pre-conditions: Very long conversation near context limit
Expected Result: Compaction happens seamlessly; assistant retains summary continuity; no error UI

Title: Battery/data session
Steps: 1. 20-min active chat session on battery. 2. Note battery + network use.
Expected Result: No abnormal drain/heat; request count sane (no request storm)
Evidence: Manual device required - battery + network for a 20-minute active chat session
Notes: Run on device; cannot be measured in-browser
